Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner failed to correctly identify the author of "The New New Rules" as Bill Maher. The show "The New New Rules" was hosted by Chelsea Handler, not Bill Maher. Bill Maher hosts "Real Time with Bill Maher." This fundamental error in identifying the author/host led the entire conversation to search for the wrong show ("Real Time with Bill Maher") instead of the correct show ("Chelsea Handler's The New New Rules"), resulting in an answer for the wrong program.
